name: Chicken 65
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix chicken with ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, salt, lemon juice, egg, rice flour, and corn flour to coat well.
2. Let the chicken marinate for at least 30-45 minutes.
3. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or kadhai over medium-high heat.
4. Carefully drop the chicken pieces into the hot oil and deep-fry until golden brown and crispy, then remove and drain on paper towels.
5. In a separate small pan, heat a teaspoon of oil and fry the curry leaves and slit green chilies until fragrant.
6. Add the fried chicken to the tempering pan and toss quickly for one minute to infuse flavors.
7. Serve hot as an appetizer with sliced onions and lemon wedges.
description: Chicken 65 is an iconic spicy, deep-fried chicken dish originating from Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Legend attributes its creation to A.M. Buhari of the Buhari Hotel in 1965. It is celebrated as a quintessential South Indian starter, known for its vibrant red color, sharp tanginess, and the distinct aroma of curry leaves.
